maria_cs: Heads up — weekly spend review for BlueHarbor (hosted). Commit = $15k/mo. This week burn shows $7.1k and we received a spend anomaly flag for a single-day burst (+140% day-over-day). Anyone on the infra side see correlating traffic?

alert-bot: SPEND ANOMALY: BlueHarbor hosted  spend +140% vs recent baseline. Severity: medium. https://alerts.redwood.internal/evt/2123469999

sam_engine: Looking at metrics now. There's a short window (02:50-03:40 UTC) with streaming session count x6. Possibly a new client-side feature toggled. Query: `SELECT client_id, count(*) FROM sessions WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-18T02:50Z' AND '2026-03-18T03:40Z' GROUP BY client_id` — returns client_x17 = primary culprit.

jess_onboarding: I just heard from their PM. They launched an opt-in analytics sdk yesterday to test in prod. They thought it was low-volume. Asking them to pause immediately.

oliver_analytics: I'll push a client_id dimension and region split to the temporary dashboard. ETA 15m. Recommend adding a short-lived token cap and an email to the PM explaining spending impact.

ian_billing: From billing view: remaining commit coverage ~$8k. If current burn continues we'll hit commit by mid-month and default to pay-as-you-go. Recommend manual cap until we have clarity. I'll also pre-authorize an invoice hold escalation if burn >70% commit for 48h.

sam_engine: Implemented temporary cap: `POST /internal/admin/accounts/blueharbor/caps {"daily_token_cap":130000}`. Also patched ingress to reject requests with `analytics_mode=verbose` as a safety rule. Watching for client errors.

maria_cs: Good. Jess please send a quick note to the PM: confirm pause, explain temporary cap, offer a short follow-up to review options (rate limits, batching, or Dedicated).

jess_onboarding: Draft sent: "We've paused the experimental analytics stream and applied a temporary cap to prevent unexpected spend. We'll share a usage breakdown and recommended mitigations. Let us know when you're ready to discuss Dedicated or rate-limiting options."

ian_billing: Opening billing ticket #BILL-4422 to track potential overage and escalation.

oliver_analytics: Dashboard updated: https://dash.redwood.com/boards/blueharbor-spend-2026  added client split. Snapshot: client_x17 is 87% of the burst.

sam_engine: Token rate trended down after cap. No significant 5xx from reject rule.

maria_cs: TL;DR: temporary caps and ingress reject rule applied, analytics board added, customer notified, billing ticket opened. Let's sync in 24h and decide if we need to recommend Dedicated or expanded commit. :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: Closing unless new alerts come in.
